name: XDKNet 2.5.9
body:
Android TV 2.5.9, alongside XDKNet server plugin 2.1.0.8 (Emby 2.0.5.8).

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

## New

- **Where to watch.** A title you don't have yet shows which streaming
  services carry it, grouped as Stream, Free, Rent and Buy, on its Seerr
  page and in search. A title you do have shows an "Also on" line with the
  services it's on. The region follows your device; change it or switch
  this off under Details screen settings. Needs a TMDB key in the plugin's
  settings (TMDB Integration), the same one episode ratings use.
- **Your year in review.** Every viewer gets their own year: hours watched,
  top shows and films, top genres, biggest day, longest streak and more,
  as a set of cards you move through with Left and Right. It's under your
  profile menu any time, and a card on Home offers it in December and
  January. It only ever shows your own watching. The plugin now keeps
  every play for this, so this year is covered from when the plugin
  started keeping track.
- **Music without gaps, at an even volume.** Albums now play from one track
  into the next with no pause, and quiet and loud songs play at a similar
  level, using the loudness Jellyfin measures. **Crossfade** is new and off
  by default: switch it on in the music player's menu or under Settings >
  Playback > Audio. It never fades between tracks of an album played in
  order.
- **Smart lists**, off by default. Switch them on under Settings >
  Libraries > Smart lists. Then any library view with filters or a sort can
  be saved as a list that keeps itself up to date, such as "Unwatched · 4K
  · 1990s", and shown as a row on Home if you want. Lists are under
  Favorites > Smart lists and follow you to every device.

## For server owners

- For even volume on Jellyfin, turn on the LUFS scan in the music library's
  options and let the Audio Normalization task run.
- For where to watch, fill in the TMDB key under Plugins > XDKNet > TMDB
  Integration if it isn't already.

Pair with plugin 2.1.0.8 (Emby 2.0.5.8).
